q1.instructions:
Tokens are split at spaces and at each punctuation mark. Where does the [[ ]] token stand in a name? A name is the proper name of a particular person, organisation, place, product, work, event or other thing. Ordinary words, dates, numbers, and marks that are not part of a name's own spelling are OUT.

Snippet: [[Mount]] Everest is tall.

criteria.BEGIN: first token of a name of two or more tokens
criteria.INSIDE: a middle token of a name
criteria.END: last token of a name of two or more tokens
